name: credit-usage-card

frames.best_why: The whole card is visible at rest: meter, toggle, table and footer with no popover covering them.

tagline: Billing card with a segmented credit meter and a usage table.
summary: A monospace credit-usage card: a 56.4% headline, an auto-switch toggle, a long segmented orange meter, a period picker, a four-row usage table and small export and plan actions.
appearance: A tall dark monospace card. A small Credits Used label over a large 56.4% sits beside a two-line caption and a tiny green toggle. Seventy-five thin orange bars form a meter, then credit labels, a dashed divider, a Usage History heading with a 30 Days pill, a four-column table and a footer with a Manage plan pill.
behaviour: The toggle springs its knob between green and grey, and the period pill opens a compact popover of durations with a tick on the chosen one. Usage rows brighten on hover, and the download icon flashes green for a moment after a CSV export.
demo_content: Credits used 56.4%; 56.4M of 100M; rows for Nov 21 gpt-4.1 4.2M $12.60 and similar.
use_when: A SaaS or API product shows how much of a monthly quota is spent and which models drove it.
avoid_when: Real-time metering: the figures are fixed props and there is no live refresh or error state.
customise: Percentage, the credit labels and the usage history array are props; auto-switch, view-all and plan callbacks are optional, while colours and the 75-segment meter are fixed.
weight_why: Seventy-five tiny meter bars and a small popover; nothing animates in a loop.

a11y.note: Controls are buttons with titles, but the usage table is built from divs and the toggle has no switch role or state.

issues: The 75 thin meter bars blur into one strip instead of reading as separate segments.
Table headers, rows and labels are extremely small and low contrast.
polish_why: Dense but tidy billing card with a distinctive meter; tiny type and blurry segments are flaws.
title: Credit Usage Card
